name: manual_b85d46
claim: Never label a CI failure flaky or recommend a rerun from proxy signals alone. First read the failing assertion and trace the exercised code path; a passing/failing sample with no local diff can still be a deterministic bug whose triggering event order is uncommon.

decisions.notes: Separated from lesson_757476abb44e so the anti-hand-waving method remains structured recall guidance after the authorization-only supersession.
